subject: Olive Tech - security qualification & compliance roadmap
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bradley Chen <brad.chen@olivetech.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@olivetech.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: security checklist & next steps

Hi Bradley / Lina —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the concrete next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Current asks we heard from Olive Tech:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and evidence of scope
   - Confirmation on GDPR / HIPAA coverage and whether Redwood will sign a BAA
   - Vendor security questionnaire completed (you shared it during the call)
   - Data residency / region options (US East requirement called out)

2) What Redwood will provide this week:
   - SOC 2 summary and attestation (redacted) — attached (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf)
   - Completed vendor questionnaire (attached as workbook template) — we’ll fill and return
   - Compliance roadmap doc outlining ISO 27001 timing and FedRAMP scoping — attached (Redwood_Compliance_Roadmap_2026.pdf)
   - BAA template and DocuSign link for legal review (link below)

3) Proposed next interactions:
   - Technical deep-dive with Rafael (Solutions Engineering) to go over encryption, key management, and deployment options (Dedicated / Private) — 60 minutes
   - Legal / procurement touchpoint to review BAA and PO timelines

Proposed timeline: questionnaire returned within 3 business days, technical deep-dive next week (I’ll include Rafael availability below).

Attachments: OliveTech_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (blank copy), Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf, Redwood_Compliance_Roadmap_2026.pdf

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqExampleSharedDrive (shared folder with artifacts), DocuSign BAA: https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/BAA-template

If that aligns, I’ll schedule the technical session and loop in legal/procurement.

Thanks,

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

> 
> --

From: Bradley Chen <brad.chen@olivetech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@olivetech.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security checklist & next steps

Aisha —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifying questions before we schedule the tech deep-dive: 

- SOC 2: Type II report — will you be able to provide the most recent period’s report (redacted) and a concise list of what products/features were in-scope (hosted API, dedicated pools, private deployments)?
- BAA: Is Redwood willing to sign a standard BAA/BAA addendum for HIPAA-covered workloads?
- Data residency: can you commit to keeping our tenant in us-east-1 for both storage and inference?
- ISO / FedRAMP: your roadmap doc mentioned FedRAMP scoping — do you have an estimated timeline or target authority-to-operate (ATO) window? Our compliance team is trying to understand multi-cloud vendor timelines.

Also, procurement will need the completed vendor questionnaire. Please confirm expected turnaround and whether you need any clarification on specific questions in the workbook.

Thanks,
Bradley

---
On Thu, 9 Apr 2026 at 08:35 AM Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@olivetech.com> wrote:
> Adding procurement context: PO and vendor approval require SOC 2 > signed BAA > vendor questionnaire backfilled. Timeline target: vendor approval in 3 weeks.

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bradley Chen <brad.chen@olivetech.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@olivetech.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security checklist & next steps

Bradley / Lina —

Thanks — quick answers inline and next steps: 

- SOC 2: Attached is a redacted SOC 2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf) and a short scope note: hosted API + dedicated inference pools + private control plane were in scope for the 2025 audit. We can share a redacted full report under an NDA if required.

- BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads and we are able to sign a BAA. I’ve linked our BAA template (DocuSign) in the shared folder; if you have a preferred legal redline process we’ll follow that.

- Data residency: For hosted customers we can pin tenant data and inference to us-east-1; we’ll document the deployment region and ensure storage and compute remain within that region. Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are also available if you need customer-managed networking.

- ISO / FedRAMP: High-level: ISO 27001 gap assessment and scoping begins Q3 2026; target certification window H1 2027 if no major gaps. FedRAMP: initial scoping kicked off; target preliminary readiness assessment in 2027 and Authority-to-Operate (ATO) planning for 2028 (this is high level and depends on partner JAB timelines). Full details in the attached roadmap (Redwood_Compliance_Roadmap_2026.pdf).

Next steps I’ll execute this week:
 - Rafael will lead tech deep-dive (topics: encryption, KMS options, tenant isolation, logging/audit) — Rafael, can you propose 2x 60-min slots next week?
 - We’ll complete the vendor questionnaire and return within 3 business days — see attached workbook.
 - I’ll add legal to the thread for the BAA / PO process once you confirm preferred contacts.

Best,

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bradley Chen <brad.chen@olivetech.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Technical deep-dive prep and questionnaire plan

Hi team —

I’ll take point on the technical deep-dive. A few notes for Olive Tech so we can be efficient in the session: 

What I’ll cover (60m):
 - Tenant isolation and network topology (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
 - Encryption: TLS1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest; customer KMS supported for Private deployments and dedicated customer-managed key options for Dedicated instances
 - Audit & logs: audit logging, token-level tracing, and retention windows (can be configured per-account)
 - SOC evidence mapping: where specific controls are implemented (we’ll point to artifacts in the shared drive)
 - Disaster recovery & backup strategy for us-east-1 (RTO/RPO targets)

Attachments I’m dropping in the shared folder: technical-architecture-diagram.svg and a short control-mapping table (map controls to product components).

Please have procurement or security team members raise any high-priority questionnaire items now so we can prepare focused answers. I’m free next week on Tuesday 4/14 10:00–12:00 PT and Wednesday 4/15 14:00–16:00 PT — can hold one slot for you.

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

From: Bradley Chen <brad.chen@olivetech.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@olivetech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive prep and questionnaire plan

Aisha / Rafael —

Thanks, that looks good. We’ll take the Tuesday 4/14 10:00 PT slot for the deep-dive and will bring a security engineer + our procurement rep. Please include legal if you can so we can speed the BAA review. 

Procurement note: timeline still target vendor approval in 3 weeks; if SOC 2 evidence and questionnaire come back this week we should be able to hit that.

I’ll upload our completed questionnaire questions where you shared the workbook and flag any items that need additional evidence.

Best,
Bradley
Head of InfoSec, Olive Tech
brad.chen@olivetech.com
